mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and compressing equity valuation multiples, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust consumer demand expansion, increasing corporate revenue expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint acceleration of HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 102.0) signals robust manufacturing output, indicating strong corporate earnings momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 102.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive equity returns through improved sector sentiment over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 1.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate increase exceeding 0.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals potential central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% m/m.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in employment growth (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint acceleration of PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months signals strong housing sector demand, driving positive equity returns through improved consumer confidence and sector performance over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increases by at least 1.0% over 3 months.
